Provincial Councils Notifications
NORTHERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Transfer of Court Fines and Penalties Statute of the Northern Province Provincial Council No. 01 of 2017

NOTICE is hereby given that the Northern Province Provincial Council has adopted the Transfer of Court Fines and PenaltiesStatute of the Northern Province Provincial Council No. 01 of 2017 on 06th April 2017 and that the Hon. GovernorNorthern Province has given his Assent to it on 29th May 2017.
K. THEIVENDRAM,
Secretary,Council Secretariat,Northern Provincial Council.Council Secretariat,A 9 Road,Kaithady,25th July 2017.
TRANSFER OF COURT FINES AND PENALTIES STATUTE No. 01 OF 2017 OF THE NORTHERN
PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL

A Statute to provide for the transfer of Fines and Panalities imposed by Courts and collected under the Finance Statute ofthe Northern Province, Provincial Council No. 01 of 2014 to the Local Authorities in the Northern Province.
Be enacted by the Northern Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lankaas follows :
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A - PG 3632 — 27 (07/2017)
1. This Statute may be cited as the Tranfer of Court Fines and Penalties Statute of the Northern
Province Provincial Council No. 01 of 2017 and shall come into operation on such date as theGovernor of the Northern Province may give his assent thereto.
2. Where the Provincial Council has collected, in terms of the Finance Statute of the Northern

Province Provincial Council No. 01 of 2014, the fines and panalties imposed by courts situated inthe Northern Province the Provincial Council shall transfer the amount of such fines and penaltiesto the relevant Local Authority on a claim, in writing, by the Chief Administrative Officer of suchLocal Authority to the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance of the Province, made withina period of five years from the thirty-first day of December of the year in which such fines and
Short title
Transfer of CourtFines andpenalties

penalties were collected as aforesaid, provided that the transfer shall be made within a period ofsix months from the date of claim.
3. No claim under Section 2 shall be valid unless accompanies with a Schedule of payment of such

fines and penalties specified in the claim specifying the date of such payments, the date ofremittance of such amount by the relevant court to the Provincial Council and the Ordinance orthe Act under which such fines and penalties have been imposed with particular reference to theSchedule thereof and certified by the Registrar of the Court which imposed and charged suchfines and penalties or any other officer nominated by him on that behalf.
4. In this Statute, unless the context otherwise requires “Chief Administrative Officer” means
(a) In relation to a Municipal Council, the Municipal Commissioner ; and
(b) In relation to an Urban Council or a Pradeshiya Sabha, the Secretary thereof ;
“Local Authority” means any Municipal Council, Urban Council, or Pradeshiya Sabha and

includes any authority created and established by or under any law to exercise,perform and discharge power, duties and function corresponding to or simillar tothe powers, duties and functions exercised, performed and/or discharged by any suchCouncil or Sabha ;
“Province” means the Northern Province of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri
Lanka ;
“Provincial Council” means the Provincial Council of the Northern Province of the
Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ;
5. In the event of any inconsistency between the Tamil, Sinhala and English texts of this Statute, the
Tamil text shall prevail.
